verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Databricks serves a genuine llms.txt file at docs.databricks.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured description of its documentation, which is exactly what an AI agent would consume for agent-oriented navigation. This is corroborated by the broader agent-oriented docs ecosystem (MCP tools, CLI, SDKs) that such a file would point to. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of agents actually using this llms.txt successfully, and no documentation explicitly describing the file's design/maintenance.
